1.title: U.S. Forest Service Employees Are Freed After 15-Hour Hostage Ordeal
1.summary: The authorities said a man and his son held two employees at gunpoint in a trailer at Shasta-Trinity National Forest in Northern California.

2.title: Mourning One Tragedy at Sea, a Family Is Devastated by Another
2.summary: The Boisas went out on the San Francisco Bay to spread the ashes of one of their own. Then a wave toppled their boat.

3.title: AIPAC Closes Donor Portal to Democrats Who Voted to End Aid to Israel
3.summary: The pro-Israel lobbying group appeared to be punishing Democrats it had previously endorsed for re-election after they voted in favor of an amendment that would have cut off U.S. aid to Israel.

4.title: Iran War Live Updates: Bridges and Water Plants Hit as Strikes Stretch to 7th Straight Day
4.summary: Overnight and into Friday, Iran reported U.S. strikes on infrastructure that can serve civilian purposes and has targeted similar sites in Gulf countries that host American bases. In the afternoon, the U.S. military announced a new round of attacks on Iran.

5.title: Trump threatens new Canada tariffs over fires sending 'filthy' air into US cities
5.summary: Canadian leader Mark Carney says both the US and Canada have an equal responsibility to fight climate change, which experts say are worsening wildfire conditions.

6.title: White House defends Argentina team over Falklands banner
6.summary: The comments could further fuel the row over the incident, which has seen Downing Street back calls for Fifa to investigate.
